email.subject: MV VALDA CREST - Rotterdam line-up: berth occupied
email.body:
Dear Operations,

MV VALDA CREST - Rotterdam, Rijnmond Energy Coal Terminal

The coal berth is occupied. The vessel ahead is expected to complete discharge late on 26 Jan. VALDA CREST is next in line, berthing about 27 Jan 0600 UTC, subject to the vessel ahead completing as planned.

We will advise at once if the line-up changes. Please keep us informed of the vessel's ETA.

Best regards,
Operations desk
Maasport Agencies, Rotterdam

result.result:
**Judgement:** Maasport Agencies' berthing time — "about 27 Jan 0600 UTC, subject to the vessel ahead completing as planned" — is roughly 57 hours after the current port call ETA (25 Jan 2100 UTC) but is qualified ("about," "subject to") and heavy weather is expected on the route through about 24 Jan evening, so the Master's safety judgement comes first. Even so, the saving is material — an estimated 31 hours at anchor saved — so it is worth putting to the operator.

**Speed advice (simulated figures from the voyage optimisation service):** advised speed 8.3 kn, arrival at Rotterdam 27 Jan 0400 UTC, 31 anchor hours saved, 38.1 t VLSFO saved. The speed plan checks out against seaRoute: the advice adds up and arrives before the berth.

The operator should decide whether to order the reduced speed. If yes, the following would follow: (a) a speed instruction to the Master — 8.3 kn with arrival 27 Jan 0400 UTC, his judgement for the safety of the ship in the weather ahead taking precedence; (b) the ETA notice that check_notices says is due — new ETA 27 Jan 0400 UTC, since the ETA has moved 31 hours beyond the CP's 12-hour limit, to recipient roles agent and receiver; (c) a voyage management system entry for the port call ETA at Rotterdam, 27 Jan 0400 UTC. Recommend nothing be sent until the operator answers.

Dear colleagues,

This is to advise that the new ETA of MV VALDA CREST at Rotterdam is 27 Jan 0400 UTC.

The revised ETA has moved beyond the charter party's 12-hour change limit.

Maasport Agencies reports that the coal berth is occupied, with VALDA CREST next in line. Berthing is expected about 27 Jan 0600 UTC, subject to the vessel ahead completing discharge late on 26 Jan.

Please let us know if you require any further information.

Best regards,

draft.subject: Berth delay Rotterdam - speed reduction instruction
draft.body:
Dear Master,

Please reduce speed to 8.3 kn, with arrival at Rotterdam 27 Jan 0400 UTC.

Your judgement for the safety of the ship in the expected heavy weather takes precedence.

Maasport Agencies reports the coal berth at Rotterdam Rijnmond Energy Coal Terminal is occupied and VALDA CREST is next in line. Berthing about 27 Jan 0600 UTC, subject to the vessel ahead completing discharge late on 26 Jan.

This is estimated to save 31 anchor hours and 38.1 t VLSFO.

Operations
